# nexus host

Configured hosts

## Usage

```
nexus host [flags]
```

## Flags

```
  -h, --help   help for host
```

## Global flags

```
      --host string   target hosts: configured names, comma-separated, or all (default: NEXUS_HOST, then the default host)
      --verbose       log each request and response status to stderr
```

## Commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`nexus host add`](nexus_host_add.md) | Register a host and pin its certificate |
| [`nexus host get`](nexus_host_get.md) | List configured hosts, or show one |
| [`nexus host remove`](nexus_host_remove.md) | Remove a configured host and its token |
